\begin{minipage}{0.95\linewidth}\vspace{4pt}\scriptsize \textit{Notes:} Dependent variable: growth of real GDP per capita (\%, average over the years shown). t\_p is the first year of period p and t\_p $-$ 1 the last year of the previous period. Columns 1--6: non-overlapping five-year averages, 1979--2023; column 7: three-year averages, 1979--2023; column 8: annual panel, 1996--2023, with lagged growth. Period-mean controls (draft 7): log GDP per capita in t\_p $-$ 1, human capital in t\_p and period means of investment, openness, inflation, population growth and commodity terms-of-trade growth. Predetermined controls: the same variables in t\_p $-$ 1 (in t $-$ 1 in column 8). Column 5 drops investment, the mediator proposed in H4. Column 6 divides the wage bill by trend GDP from the Hamilton filter (H = 2, k = 2). Country and period fixed effects; standard errors clustered by country (t distribution with G $-$ 1 degrees of freedom), except column 8 (Driscoll-Kraay, maximum lag 3, t distribution with T $-$ 1 degrees of freedom). Wild cluster bootstrap p-values: Webb weights, 9,999 replications, clustered by country. The second panel restricts each specification to the draft-7 baseline sample (365 country-periods), keeping the country-periods that also have the variables of that column. Microstates excluded. * p<0.10, ** p<0.05, *** p<0.01.\end{minipage}
